name: April Fool no Kami ni Otouto o Moraimashita!
original_name: エイプリルフールの神に弟をもらいました！
source:
It's April Fool's Day today!
I (the protagonist), however, have been really into this popular game that just came out.
The 1st of April was going to end soon, but then a mysterious old man appeared in front of me.
He proclaimed himself to be the god of April Fools' and announced he was going to give me a younger brother as a gift.
A yandere younger brother, a tsundere younger brother, an inexpressive younger brother.
I'm supposed to choose one of them, but...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27171]Freem![/url]]
translation:
今天是愚人节！
而我（主角）却非常喜欢这款刚刚推出的热门游戏。
4月1日马上就要结束了，然而一位神秘的老人却出现在了我的面前。
他自称是愚人节之神，并宣布要送给我一个弟弟作为礼物。
病娇弟弟，傲娇弟弟，不善表达的弟弟。
我应该选择其中之一，但是…

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27171]Freem![/url]]
